Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an incorrect analysis in Step 2 by concluding that "velocity becomes negative while acceleration remains positive." This is incorrect because the velocity remains positive (as it continues to point downward, albeit at a slower magnitude), while the acceleration becomes negative (indicating deceleration in the direction opposite to the velocity).
